quest.unpredictableblocks.anachronisme.h: Ravagers come with raids: kill a pillager captain, then enter a village.
quest.unpredictableblocks.boulangerie.hi: Bone meal speeds up wheat. Both objectives are required.
quest.unpredictableblocks.bsod.glitched: Have Blindness and Nausea at the same time
quest.unpredictableblocks.bsod.hint: Some BSOD Lucky Block outcomes 'crash' you: break one and hope.
quest.unpredictableblocks.volaille.hint: Found in villages. Bring a bow and keep your distance.
quest.unpredictableblocks.impots.hint: Trade with villagers: every emerald spent within 8 blocks counts.
quest.unpredictableblocks.streamer.hint: Plains at night are full of zombies.
quest.unpredictableblocks.proprete.hint: The big clean-up starts with zombies.
quest.unpredictableblocks.gravite_zero.h: End shulkers inflict it, and so do some Zero Gravity Lucky Blocks.
quest.unpredictableblocks.fast_food.hint: You need a saddle (dungeon chests, fishing, trading).
quest.unpredictableblocks.cauchemar_mati: A bed = 3 wool + 3 planks. Sleep at night.
quest.unpredictableblocks.film_action.hi: Slow Falling potion: phantom membrane + awkward potion.
quest.unpredictableblocks.jdr_d20.hint: Don't look it in the eyes... unless you're ready. A carved pumpkin protects you.
quest.unpredictableblocks.penurie_2020.h: 3 sugar cane = 3 paper. Build a farm by the water.
quest.unpredictableblocks.complot.hint: 5 gold ingots. Also keeps piglins calm.
quest.unpredictableblocks.lag_bug.hint: Find a stronghold with Eyes of Ender and activate the portal.
quest.unpredictableblocks.disco_80.music: Play a music disc in a jukebox
quest.unpredictableblocks.disco_80.hint: Discs: dungeon chests, or a skeleton killing a creeper.
quest.unpredictableblocks.plomberie.ches: Open a chest during the plumbing alert
quest.unpredictableblocks.plomberie.hint: Break a Plumbing Lucky Block: a time window opens, open a chest quickly.
quest.unpredictableblocks.fortune_cookie: Type the fortune code in chat in time
A Fortune Cookie Lucky Block may give a code: type it in chat within 5 s.
quest.unpredictableblocks.camping.hint: Snowy biomes. Adults protect their cubs!
quest.unpredictableblocks.gym_bro.buff: Get Strength then Slowness III within 30 s
quest.unpredictableblocks.gym_bro.hint: Drink a Strength potion, then a strong Slowness potion (or Turtle Master).
quest.unpredictableblocks.magie_comptoir: Forests and taigas. Careful, they attack in packs.
quest.unpredictableblocks.invasion_memes: The BONK Hammer drops from Meme Invasion Lucky Blocks. Hit anything.
quest.unpredictableblocks.pause_cafe.hin: If your hunger bar is empty, the counter resets. Eat first!
quest.unpredictableblocks.retard_vol.hin: Suitcases drop from Flight Delay Lucky Blocks.
quest.unpredictableblocks.ananas_pizza.s: Defeat 10 Italian Chefs without eating pineapple
quest.unpredictableblocks.ananas_pizza.h: Eating the Debate Slice fails the quest until the next summon.
quest.unpredictableblocks.speedrunner.en: Reach the End within 3 min of a Speedrunner Lucky Block
quest.unpredictableblocks.speedrunner.hi: Prepare everything (Eyes of Ender, portal found) BEFORE breaking the block.
quest.unpredictableblocks.piraterie_torr: The hard drive drops from Torrent Piracy Lucky Blocks.
quest.unpredictableblocks.asmr_fidget.bu: Break 50 white wool or honeycomb blocks
quest.unpredictableblocks.asmr_fidget.hi: Place and break the same wool over and over: every break counts.
quest.unpredictableblocks.vampire_gothiq: Defeat Count Dracula without metal armor
Leather or nothing: iron, gold, chain, diamond and netherite count as metal.
quest.unpredictableblocks.multivers_slid: Cross 3 biomes during the gravity flip
Break a Multiverse Lucky Block, then run: you have 2 minutes.
